articles.title: DICGC Deposit Insurance: Architecture, Coverage Limits, and Capacity Structures in Indian Banking
articles.summary: An exhaustive, audio-native technical treatise on the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Act of 1961, the five-lakh-rupee statutory insurance ceiling, capacity-based ownership structures, the ninety-day liquidation mandate under Section 18A, subrogation jurisprudence, and systemic deposit safety in India.
